en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a city with wooded hills in the background. In the foreground is a lake or pond with many people rowing small boats. Behind the trees along the shore stands a prominent building with a tower and spire. Beyond this, the city of Graz spreads up the hillside. Printed text at the top in German identifies the scene as a view over the city from Hilmteich.
